features.name: Show and lock orientation
features.note: WinUI 3 content area renders completely blank. 0/5 controls present (all four Prefer* checkboxes and the Apply preferences button missing from both the UIA tree and screenshot); all output text (Native/Current orientation, Auto-rotation preferences) absent. Blank page persists after manual navigation. UWP golden shows the full page. Behavioral responsiveness is not a differentiator (the Apply button produced no visible change even in UWP with no checkbox selected); the failure is total absence of scenario content.
